Become a part of our caring community

The Research Operations Lead keeps our Design Research practice running smoothly. This role partners with Design Research leadership to manage research knowledge bases, tooling and infrastructure, practice engagement, governance, advocacy and development. You will be critical to ensuring efficient research delivery that contributes to unique user-centered experiences for Medicare consumers.

Who We Are

Humana's Experience Design (XD) team, within the Consumer Digital organization, strives to eliminate friction in today's healthcare ecosystem. This effort aims to make consumers feel confident, respected, and heard in the decisions affecting their health.

The Research Operations Lead is responsible for developing, standardizing, and maintaining scalable research practices to allow the Design Research team to expand its impact. These activities include management of insights repositories, methods and tools, research documentation; coordination with research tool suppliers; facilitating practice meetings and comms; tracking research contributions and impact; maintaining research policies and standards; supporting the professional development of the team and advocating for the value and visibility of the practice.

This is a remote role reporting to the Associate VP Head of Design Research.

Key Responsibilities:

Knowledge Management

  • Sets up and maintains insights repositories, the research toolkit, and other file sharing spaces across channels

  • Gathers and maintains best practices, methodological guidance, templates

  • Sets up and maintains taxonomy, tagging, findability and access, archiving rules across knowledge management resources; tracks utilization of same

Tooling and Infrastructure

  • Manages access, permissions, utilization of research tools/software/platforms

  • Drives vendor contracting and renewals for research tools

  • Vendor account management, functioning as point of contact for team needs and requests

  • Maintains transparent cost and budget tracking for recruitment and research vendors

Practice Engagement

  • Partners with Design Research leadership to coordinate and facilitate cross-practice meetings and events

  • Engages across Experience Design partners to support practice participation in XD meetings and events

  • Shares organizational communications and updates

  • Calendars, tracks, and reports on research capacity, contributions, and impact

Governance

  • Maintains and updates research policies, standards, and compliance procedures

  • Supports team training and accountability on same

  • Shares organizational guidance, facilitates Q&A on Humana policies and expectations

Advocacy and Development

  • Facilitates activities associated with setting and pursuing practice goals

  • Supports collective development of the team and partners, e.g. peer feedback sessions, collective trainings and demos

  • Communicates research contributions, best practices, and impact broadly across the organization

  • Supports advancements in and ethical use of AI-enabled research

Participant Management

  • Sets up and maintains specialized panels through our own toolset, as needed

  • Collaborates with other research teams across the enterprise to set up and use specialized panels through their toolset, as needed


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 8-10 years of experience delivering research ops contributions within digital product organizations

  • 5-8 years of experience independently managing research ops

  • Exceptional communication, problem-solving, organizational and operational coordination skills; ability to work collaboratively in a complex team and stakeholder environment

SYSTEMS ENGINEER PRINCIPAL

Advance how our customers operate while you advance your career. Join GDIT as a Systems Engineer Principal and build an impactful career in enterprise IT, collaborating with people who are driven and resourceful like you.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As a Systems Engineer Principal, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of NOAA’s National Weather Service (NWS). You will play a crucial role in sustaining and improving the High Performance Computing (HPC) systems that generate the nation’s operational weather and climate forecasts, enabling NWS to deliver timely, accurate information that protects life and property.

  • Lead/Manage/Support daily HPC system operations and the reliability of the scheduling and system software stack that powers NOAA’s 24/7 numerical weather prediction mission
    ● Collaborate with experienced GDIT HPC engineers, system administrators, developers, and NWS operational staff to troubleshoot issues, enhance system performance, and ensure consistent delivery of high‑impact forecasting products
    ● Drive improvements in system efficiency, scheduler reliability, job throughput, and operational resiliency by analyzing complex problems, proposing innovations, and supporting implementation of technical enhancements
    ● Utilize Linux system administration, HPC scheduler expertise (PBS Pro/Slurm), scripting languages, performance monitoring tools, and parallel computing technologies to keep two large‑scale supercomputing systems running at peak performance

● Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science
● Experience: 8+ years of related experience

    – Experience with HPC batch schedulers (PBS Pro, Slurm, or similar)
    – Scripting abilities (Bash, Python, Perl)
    – Understanding of HPC architectures, distributed computing, and MPI-based workloads
    – Troubleshooting skills across multi-node HPC environments
    ● US citizenship required
    ● Role requirements:
    – Ability to participate in an on-call rotation supporting 24/7 operational systems
    – Occasional travel for team collaboration, training, or customer interaction

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

115K - 135K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $115,000 – $135,000 / year

raw.description:
At West, we’re a dedicated team that is connected by a purpose to improve patient lives that has been at the center of our Company for more than a century. Our story began when Herman O. West solved the problem of supplying penicillin in mass quantities to the US Government during World War 2. Through our work to deliver thousands of life-saving and life-enhancing injectable medicines to millions of patients daily, West’s indelible mark on the healthcare industry has just begun. A name started our story. How will yours help write our future?

There’s no better place to join an inclusive community of professionals with opportunities for lifelong learning, growth and development. Supported by benefit programs, we empower the physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our team members and their families.

We believe in giving back to help those in need in the communities where we live and work. And are equally committed to creating a healthier environment and planet through our sustainability efforts.

Job Summary

The VP, Commercial is responsible for defining and executing the global commercial strategy across the West Vantage Operating Unit (“OU”), including all regions and segments. Reporting to the OU President and serving as a member of the OU Senior Leadership Team, this role drives sustainable revenue growth, margin expansion, and long-term value creation.

In a highly regulated Pharma Services/CDMO environment, the VP, Commercial for West Vantage ensures commercial excellence across the full customer lifecycle—from early-stage development partnerships through commercial manufacturing and lifecycle management—while aligning growth strategy with operational capacity, regulatory requirements, and capital investment priorities.

This role leads all global commercial functions for the OU, including Marketing and Commercial Operations, and Account Management and Business Development for Strategic Global Accounts, Channel Partners, and Emerging and Mid-Tier Pharma. A key responsibility will be to shape the commercial organization, standards, and processes, while driving high-value growth across the global network, strategically focused on drug/device assembly and packaging, as well as integrated combination product services. This role will be positioned as a possible future successor to the OU President.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

OU Commercial Strategy

  • Define and execute a multi-year global commercial strategy aligned with corporate objectives and the 10-year strategic plan
  • Shape growth priorities across customer segments, geographies, and offerings
  • Lead global go-to-market architecture across early development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing
  • Present commercial strategy, outlook, and growth scenarios to executive leadership
  • Lead strategic and tactical marketing in support of strategic planning and market adoptions, including market sizing, pipeline modeling, offering definition, and multi-channel marketing plans (trade shows, digital marketing, sales enablement tools, etc.)

Revenue Growth & Margin Expansion

  • Lead commercial organization to meet or exceed strategic plan revenue and margin commitments, driving sustainable, profitable revenue growth across all regions and segments
  • Own global pricing strategy, program scope, investment models, and value-based selling frameworks
  • Manage the opportunity gating and proposals process to ensure alignment to customer scope, execution requirements, commercial thresholds, and strategic business priorities
  • Manage and track investment models to ensure adherence to program assumptions
  • Establish disciplined deal governance through structured approval frameworks and commercial policy oversight
  • Lead targeting and lead generation, and implement tracking mechanisms

Strategic Account & Portfolio Management

  • Oversee enterprise strategic account governance, including executive sponsorship models
  • Drive long-term lifecycle partnerships with key pharma, biotech and channel partners
  • Conduct whitespace and adjacency analysis to expand share of wallet
  • Influence portfolio prioritization through customer and market insights

M&A & Commercial Integration

  • Lead commercial due diligence in acquisitions and strategic partnerships
  • Assess revenue synergies and market expansion opportunities
  • Oversee commercial integration planning post-acquisition
  • Ensure seamless customer continuity during integration processes

Additional Responsibilities

Digital Commercial Transformation

  • Drive CRM optimization, AI-enabled forecasting, and advanced analytics adoption
  • Implement standardized global commercial processes and data governance
  • Develop omnichannel engagement strategies tailored to pharma, biotech, and channel partner expectations
  • Strengthen forecasting accuracy to support capacity and capital planning

Customer Experience & Lifecycle Management

  • Champion a customer-centric culture across the OU
  • Design differentiated service models aligned with segment complexity (e.g., emerging biotech vs. large pharma)
  • Integrate Voice-of-Customer insights into new service offerings, business models and operational design
  • Ensure seamless coordination between Commercial, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, and other cross-functional stakeholders

Global Operating Model & Organizational Leadership

  • Define the global commercial operating model across regions and business offerings
  • Establish sales compensation philosophy aligned with margin and growth objectives
  • Standardize global account management frameworks
  • Build and lead a high-performing, diverse commercial organization
  • Develop succession planning and enterprise leadership capabilities

Key Performance Indicators

  • Revenue growth (organic and inorganic)
  • Gross margin expansion
  • Pricing realization and discount discipline
  • Strategic account penetration and retention
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Pipeline conversion rates
  • Post-M&A revenue synergy realization

Leadership Impact

  • Embedding commercial discipline in capacity planning
  • Strengthening long-term supply agreements
  • Enhancing predictability of revenue streams
  • Improving margin resilience in regulated markets
  • Supporting innovation through customer insight integration

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent required
  • Master's degree or equivalent preferred

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 20 years of work experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in Sales and/or Marketing roles
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in progressive Leadership roles

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with a variety of internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership, Board membersand colleagues
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey ideas, negotiate, and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • Ability to listen, partner, and team with other leaders on decisions and gain credibility with leadership internally and at clients by consistently delivering business-oriented advice in a timely fashion
  • Sees the big picture, connects the dots, and creates strategies to achieve the competitive advantage; can see the possibilities, defines the map to get there and translates actions into meaningful value
  • Demonstrated ability to understand regulatory environments (FDA, etc.), long term supply agreements, tech transfer dynamics, and Lifecycle management
  • Ability to attract, develop, and mentor talent, build high-performing teams, and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning

Travel Requirements

40% Up to 104 business days per year

Physical Requirements

Sedentary-Exerting up to 10lbs/4kgs of force occasionally, and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.

What We Offer

This is a remote position allowing the team member to work from home
Inclusive & Collaborative Culture: A global workforce that values diversity, equity, and inclusion—where all voices are heard and respected in a supportive environment.
Global Career Opportunities: With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, employees have opportunities for international exposure and cross-functional collaboration.
Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):Flexible vacation, personal, and holiday leave ensures employees can maintain a healthy work-life balance and recharge effectively.
Community Involvement: West encourages volunteerism through its West without Borders initiative and other charitable programs that make a difference in local communities.
Continuous Learning & Development: Opportunities for professional growth through training programs, tuition assistance, leadership development, and skill-certification initiatives.

raw.title: Facilities Manager
raw.excerpt: At Petfolk, we’re reshaping veterinary care by blending high-quality medicine with a welcoming, connected experience for pets, their families, and the professionals who care for them.
raw.description:
At Petfolk, we’re reshaping veterinary care by blending high-quality medicine with a welcoming, connected experience for pets, their families, and the professionals who care for them.

The Role

As Facilities Manager, you'll own day-to-day facilities operations across every Petfolk pet care center (PCC). Petfolk has centralized facilities decision-making intentionally. This role serves as the day-to-day owner of facilities operations, vendor coordination, and landlord accountability across the portfolio while operating within established standards, approval thresholds, and strategic direction set by the Petfolk Development team. You'll have real authority and clear ownership. You'll also operate within a structured framework of standards, approvals, and accountability. The right candidate thinks like an owner, moves with urgency and precision, and is energized by building infrastructure that supports a company growing as fast as we are.

What You'll Do

Facilities Operations Management

  • Serve as the day-to-day owner of physical facilities needs across all Petfolk PCCs — responsible for the condition, functionality, and operational capabilities of each location
  • Develop and manage preventative maintenance programs for facility-related building systems and infrastructure, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, life safety systems, doors, and other building components.
  • Monitor facility infrastructure and utility performance across the portfolio, coordinating investigations, repairs, and landlord or vendor accountability when issues arise.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of facilities requests: intake, triage, vendor dispatch, scope approval, work completion, and closeout — ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and care teams are kept informed throughout
  • Own the facilities ticketing system — maintain clean, current, and organized records of all open and closed work orders across the portfolio
  • Make repair-versus-replace decisions, authorize spend within approved thresholds, and escalate appropriately; care teams are not expected to manage these independently
  • Respond to facility emergencies and after-hours escalations, including weekends and holidays as needed
  • Partner with internal teams to project manage facilities-driven improvements across the Petfolk portfolio — including interior refreshes, flooring, and other capital or cosmetic work driven by location age, condition, or brand standards

Financial Stewardship

  • Provide recommendations and data to support facilities budgeting and forecasting efforts; monitor portfolio spend, track budget performance, and ensure facilities expenditures remain aligned with approved financial plans.
  • Manage and oversee PCC-level facilities spend; review and validate invoices prior to payment; identify billing discrepancies and cost recovery opportunities

Vendor & Landlord Management

  • Serve as Petfolk's primary day-to-day point of contact for landlord-related facilities matters, including maintenance responsibilities, building systems, utility concerns, service interruptions, and lease-obligated repairs, escalating matters as appropriate within the Development team.
  • Manage existing vendor relationships nationwide; build a centralized vendor tracking system; evaluate performance, close gaps, and source new partners as the portfolio grows
  • Interpret lease agreements to identify landlord obligations; pursue cost recovery and maintain documentation of claims, disputes, and unresolved issues

Construction Partnership

  • Partner closely with the Construction team on new hospital openings, facility readiness, and the transition from construction to ongoing facilities operations.
  • Serve as the primary facilities partner for post-opening facility issues, helping identify, document, triage, and coordinate resolution of construction-related items in collaboration with the Construction teams.
  • Maintain close coordination with the Construction team during the GC warranty period to ensure facility-related issues are appropriately routed, documented, and resolved through the proper channels.

Systems, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain accurate facilities reporting and provide regular updates to leadership on portfolio performance, vendor accountability, operational risks, and budget adherence.
  • Accountable for meeting established facilities performance metrics, including responsiveness, resolution timelines, preventative maintenance execution, vendor performance, and financial stewardship.
  • Build SOPs, escalation pathways, and preventative maintenance programs that support a growing multi-site portfolio.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities for operational improvement, standardization, and cost savings.

Who You Are

  • Exceptional judgment — repair vs. replace, landlord vs. vendor, speed vs. cost; knows which lever to pull and when
  • Strong ownership mentality — follows through, closes the loop, and proactively keeps leadership informed
  • Financially literate — evaluates proposals critically, tracks spend against budget, identifies cost recovery opportunities, and understands the financial impact of facilities decisions.
  • Highly organized and detail obsessed — catches discrepancies others miss; nothing slips through
  • Proficient in AI tools, Google Sheets or equivalent, and facilities / ticketing platforms — builds and maintains systems without analyst support
  • Clear, professional communicator — effective with landlord reps, vendors, care teams, and leadership alike
  • Calm under pressure, naturally proactive, and accountable across a seven-day operating week

Education & Experience

  • 3–5 years in facilities management, multi-unit operations, property management, construction, or a related field
  • Multi-site experience strongly preferred — retail, healthcare, veterinary, restaurant, dental, urgent care, or hospitality
  • Construction or facilities background preferred but not required; judgment, financial accountability, and drive matter most
  • Ability to read commercial leases and identify landlord vs. tenant obligations preferred
  • Working knowledge of commercial building systems a plus

Work Environment & Travel

  • Fully remote with travel as needed to pet care centers, vendor meetings, new hospital openings, and Petfolk HQ — up to 30%
  • Requires a dedicated workspace with reliable internet; regular communication via video, phone, email, and facilities platforms
  • Petfolk Pet Care Centers operate seven days a week, including certain holidays when Petfolk HQ offices may be closed. While this role follows a standard full-time work schedule and is not expected to work every weekend or holiday, the Facilities Manager is accountable for ensuring appropriate support systems, vendor coverage, and escalation pathways are in place to address urgent facilities issues across all operating days.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer
  • Ability to walk and inspect facilities during site visits

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $90,000-$100,000

raw.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details

Pharmacy Technicians in our Patient Engagement Center of Excellence may hold multiple duties to ensure ExactCare’s patients receive quality care out of their pharmacy services. They will work in a call center environment, spending their time speaking with patients, doctors and facilities on the phone.

Job duties and responsibilities will vary from fielding inbound phone calls, outbound phone work and navigating multiple pharmacy software systems to supporting the various stages of patient care/contact. These areas of responsibility will fluctuate based on organizational needs, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to develop multiple skillsets.

This is a remote-based environment, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to provide an exceptional over-the-phone patient experience. AnewHealth provides a fast-paced, high-energy environment, allowing Pharmacy Technicians to excel in many areas with a focus on phone-based pharmacy work.

Responsibilities

  • Providing an exceptional customer service experience each day in a phone-based environment.

  • Answering a high volume of inbound calls from current patients and serve as an ExactCare expert to resolve their questions.

  • Placing outbound calls to patients to create, maintain or update their medication profiles.

  • Effectively assist with patient questions over the phone.

  • Working through current case queues to problem solve for patient care issues.

  • Serving as a liaison between the clinical pharmacists and other medical professionals on patients’ behalf.

  • Perform claim adjudication and auditing duties such as prior authorizations, billing and eligibility checks. Requiring outbound calls to patients

  • Collect on patient balances when patient has an amount due

  • Maintaining patient records with strong attention to detail and confidentiality.

  • Utilizing sound drug knowledge to effectively receive prescription authorizations, clarifications or transfers.

  • Accurate retrieval of all prescription information and verifying through doctor calls.

  • Enter a high volume of data; processing prescription information with speed and accuracy.

  • Placing welcome calls to newly onboarded patients and establish a trusted point of contact.

  • Partner with technicians and pharmacists to ensure that new patients are successfully onboarded to ExactCare.

  • Performing in a high volume, fast paced environment to support ExactCare’s nationwide patient base.

  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.

  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

  • High school diploma /GED

  • Certified with the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or the National Health Association (NHA) and maintain a current certificate.

  • Must maintain a pharmacy technician registration with State Board of Pharmacy

Experience

  • Must be 18+ years of age

  • Prior experience in a pharmacy setting

Skills & Abilities

  • Comfortable working in a phone-based environment.

  • Ability to work independently

  • Self-motivated and goal oriented

  • Exceptional customer service skills; servicing doctor’s office, pharmacist, and patient needs over the phone.

  • Thorough drug knowledge.

  • Pharmacy billing knowledge.

  • Knowledge of appropriate processes in taking prescriptions, clarifications and transfers including clear written and verbal communication.

  • Ability to utilize computer equipment, technology and work within multiple software programs to receive medication authorizations, clarifications and/or transfers.

  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills.

  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

  • Passion to help people and enrich their lives.

  • Ability to overcome objections

  • Ability to think critically and document pertinent details in a world class manner that is compliant with state and federal regulations.

Physical/Mental Demands: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Must be able to commute to multiple site locations within assigned territory. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.

Schedule: This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

This is a remote position.

AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire.

AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.

Become a part of our caring community

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Applied AI Engineer to support advanced AI initiatives focused on generative AI, embeddings, and ServiceNow data integration.

The focus of this role is the advancement of AI capabilities in the IT Service Management (ITSM) space. The hiring team owns a large data store in Databricks Unity Catalog containing all ITSM data that this role will leverage for their work. You will work closely with data engineering and business teams to deliver scalable, intelligent solutions using Databricks and Azure.

Come join our Fortune #40, Best Places to Work company and help us make a difference as we help our members achieve their best health!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to software projects emphasizing AI systems in VSCode/Pycharm, GitHub, and Databricks.

  • Deploy and maintain AI systems across Databricks and Microsoft Azure services such as Azure Kubernetes Service.

  • Maintain and extend internal APIs, SDKs, and clients that support our projects.

  • Actively participate in architecting software and cloud solutions.

  • Communicate clearly with adjacent teams and stakeholders and manage expectations.

Why Join Us:

  • Work on high-impact AI and ML projects with real enterprise data.

  • Collaborative team environment.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge tools and technologies.

  • Opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives with visibility across the organization.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of strong, hands-on experience with Python.

  • Comfort thinking in terms of engineering systems, not coding scripts.

  • Familiarity with Databricks (including Unity Catalog, MLflow, and notebooks).

  • Strong experience with GitHub (commits, pull requests, integrations).

  • Ability to lead technical walkthroughs and articulate design decisions.

  • Experience deploying apps, servers, or ML models in a production setting.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience creating CICD workflows in GitHub and/or ADO.

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow data models.

  • Familiarity with RAG architecture, vector databases, or agentic orchestration.

  • Familiarity with developing APIs and clients. Bonus points for MCP experience.

  • JavaScript familiarity.

  • Excellent communication skills.

Additional Notes:

  • An active GitHub is required and will be requested if selected to move forward.

  • Selected candidates may be asked to complete a small take-home assessment prior to being interviewed and may be asked to do a project walkthrough and pair programming in the interview.

  • This is an advanced engineering role requiring a very technical skillset. Candidates with hands-on experience building, deploying, and supporting AI solutions and software will be most successful in this position.

Work Style:

This position's work style is remote from any of the locations listed below. You must reside in close proximity to one of these locations.

Market Location Options:

  • Louisville, KY

  • Dallas/Frisco, TX

  • Washington, DC (Arlington, VA)

  • Fort Lauderdale, FL

  • Tampa, FL

  • Atlanta, GA

  • Charlotte, NC

  • Chicago, IL

  • Nashville, TN

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$142,300 - $195,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Job title

Client Relations Manager

Department

Client Relations

Reports to

Director of Client Relations

Classification

Full-Time / Exempt

Work Location

Remote (50-miles within Atlanta, GA)

Travel Requirement

Occasional travel is required, including attendance at BELAY's annual company Summit and other business meetings as needed.

Job purpose

The Client Relations Manager leads and develops a team of Client Success Consultants responsible for delivering an exceptional client experience. This role drives team performance, client retention, and revenue growth by establishing clear expectations, monitoring results, coaching employees, and proactively addressing client and team needs.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

  • Lead and develop a team of Client Success Consultants by establishing clear objectives, performance expectations, and accountability for results.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one and team meetings to provide coaching, feedback, training, and support.
  • Monitor team performance against established client retention, revenue, service, and productivity goals, using data to identify trends and determine appropriate actions.
  • Manage employee performance by recognizing strong contributions, identifying development opportunities, and addressing performance concerns through timely coaching and documented improvement plans.
  • Ensure Client Success Consultants provide proactive, consultative support throughout the client lifecycle, including onboarding, ongoing communication, issue resolution, and account growth.
  • Review client and contractor feedback, account health indicators, and escalation trends to identify risks and improve the overall service experience.
  • Ensure at-risk accounts have documented action plans, assigned owners, and defined timelines to support client retention.
  • Coach Client Success Consultants to identify appropriate upsell, referral, and account expansion opportunities within their client portfolios.
  • Partner with the Director of Client Relations and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve escalations and support targeted retention and revenue-growth initiatives.
  • Recommend improvements to processes, systems, tools, and service delivery based on performance data, client needs, and business priorities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 3 or more years of experience in client success, account management, sales, or a related client-facing environment.
  • 1 or more years of experience leading, supervising, or coaching employees.
  • Experience managing client retention, account health, or revenue-growth initiatives.
  • Experience using performance metrics and business systems to monitor results and make informed decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach employees, address performance concerns, and manage client escalations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a client success or account management team in a remote environment.
  • Experience with customer relationship management, client success, or performance management systems.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve team efficiency or client outcomes.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong people leadership and employee coaching skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Client relationship management and consultative service skills.
  • Ability to interpret performance data and translate findings into action.
  • Strong judgment, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing needs and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate across departments.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing business needs.

Working Conditions

BELAY is a remote-first organization. This role requires a dedicated home office, regular use of virtual collaboration tools, and a work schedule that aligns with business needs and BELAY's core collaboration hours. Occasional travel or flexibility outside standard business hours may be required based on the role.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Frequent participation in virtual meetings.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through video conferencing, email, and phone.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Direct Reports

Client Success Consultant(s)

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs, and team members may be assigned additional duties as needed.

Equal Employment Opportunity

BELAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Salary range

Salary Range: $80,000 + $85,000

Location Requirements:

This role is remote within the U.S. However, due to employment and tax compliance considerations, we are currently unable to hire employees in the following states: California, New York, Illinois, Oregon.

Sobre Tenpo

¡En Tenpo estamos construyendo el futuro de las finanzas en Chile!

Hoy somos más de 400 profesionales unidos por un hito histórico: somos el primer Neobanco del país. Hemos evolucionado para crear un ecosistema financiero 100% digital, sólido e inclusivo, diseñado para derribar las barreras de la banca tradicional y ser accesible para todas las personas.

Dejamos de ser solo una app para convertirnos en la propuesta bancaria más innovadora de Chile. Aquí nos mueve la pasión por la excelencia y el propósito claro de transformar la industria con tecnología de punta y visión de futuro.

En Tenpo somos líderes, somos valientes ante los desafíos y, sobre todo, somos humanos: conectamos de verdad con las necesidades de las personas y de nuestro país.

El futuro ya llegó y tiene licencia bancaria. Vamos con todo. Con fuerza. Con visión.

Con N de Neobanco. #TenpoConNdeNeobanco 💚

Sobre el Cargo

En Tenpo, estamos buscando a nuestro/a próximo/a Ingeniero de Modelado de Datos. Quién tendrá el objetivo de diseñar, construir y optimizar modelos de datos robustos, escalables y de alta calidad dentro de nuestro Data Warehouse corporativo (BigQuery). Serás el puente técnico entre la infraestructura de datos cruda y las capas de consumo, creando estructuras analíticas limpias y consistentes que permitan a los equipos de negocio explotar la información de forma autónoma, confiable y segura en un entorno de neobanco regulado.

Responsabilidades del cargo

  • Modelado y Arquitectura Analítica: Diseñar modelos entidad-relación y definir métricas, relaciones y cardinalidades para construir los maestros corporativos y productos de datos.

  • Modelos Dimensionales y Capa Semántica: Implementar esquemas Star/Snowflake, dimensiones conformadas y Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) garantizando lógica de negocio reutilizable.

  • Desarrollo y Orquestación ELT: Construir pipelines de transformación con Dataform o dbt, asegurando trazabilidad, rendimiento y disponibilidad de la data analítica.

  • Calidad y Gobernanza: Implementar controles automatizados de calidad, mantener la documentación en el catálogo de datos y garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares de gobierno.

  • Habilitación Self-Service: Transformar necesidades complejas en productos de datos intuitivos y listos para el consumo de analistas y squads de producto.

  • Buenas Prácticas Técnicas: Aplicar control de versiones (Git), CI/CD, optimización de consultas en BigQuery y monitoreo continuo bajo metodologías ágiles.


¿Qué necesitas para postular?

  • Formación: Titulado/a de Ingeniería Civil Informática, Computación, Sistemas, Estadística o carrera afín.

  • Experiencia: Mínimo 3 años en roles de datos, con al menos 2 años diseñando e implementando modelos de datos en producción dentro de un Data Warehouse Cloud.

  • SQL Avanzado: Dominio experto en consultas analíticas complejas, optimización (CTEs, window functions, particionamiento).

  • Herramientas de Transformación: Experiencia práctica utilizando dbt o Dataform en entornos de trabajo colaborativo.

  • Ecosistema Cloud & DW: Conocimiento sólido en BigQuery (o Snowflake/Redshift) y conceptos de modelado dimensional.

  • Control de Versiones: Uso fluido de Git (branches, PRs, code review).

  • Python: Nivel intermedio para automatización y procesamiento de datos.

Deseables (Plus):

  • Experiencia previa en Fintech, Neobancos o Industria Financiera.

  • Manejo de orquestadores como Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer.

  • Nociones de Data Contracts, observabilidad y gobernanza de datos.

  • Certificaciones Cloud o de dbt (dbt Analytics Engineering, GCP Data Engineer).



Beneficios de Trabajar en Tenpo

📚 Presupuesto anual para autogestionar capacitación.

👩‍💻 Teletrabajo.

🎂 Día del cumpleaños libre.

🧁 Medio día cumpleaños hij@s/padres.

💃 Viernes cortos (todos los viernes terminamos a las 14 horas).

🌍 Work from anywhere (¡Trabaja desde donde quieras! Solo recuerda tener una buena conexión a internet).

✨ Entre muchos otros!!!

En Tenpo valoramos la diversidad y promovemos un entorno inclusivo y seguro para todas las personas, independientemente de su discapacidad, cultura, religión, etnia, género o identidad LGBTQ+.

¡Únete a nosotros y sé parte del cambio! 🚀

Job Description

The Quality Assurance Analyst executes software test plans in order to identify software problems and their causes prior to release.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Design test plans, scenarios, scripts, or procedures from complex business requirements and specifications;
  • Test system modifications to prepare for implementation;
  • Develop or specify standards, methods, or procedures to determine product quality / release readiness;
  • Develop testing programs that address areas such as database impacts, software scenarios, regression testing, negative testing, error or bug retests, or usability;
  • Document software defects, using a bug tracking system, and report defects to software developers;
  • Plan test schedules or strategies in accordance with project scope and delivery dates;
  • Test integration between systems and analyzes data;
  • Participate in product design reviews to provide input on functional requirements, product designs, schedules, or potential problems;
  • Review software documentation to ensure technical accuracy, compliance, or completeness, and to mitigate risks;
  • Document test procedures to ensure replicability and compliance with standards;
  • Assist in creating scenarios and data to be automated.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computers Science or related field AND
  • Six (6) years of experience in software testing with specific emphasis in the web applications environment and multiple database platforms OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience

Certificates and Licenses: None required.

OTHER REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to automated tests using commercial or open sources tools
  • Self-motivated, able to work independently and assume full responsibility for delivering projects on time
  • Flexibility to handle multiple projects, simultaneously
  • Knowledge of SQL and Oracle databases
  • Experience testing data transfer and system integration
  • Possess excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities and a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, software testing concepts, and test methodologies
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment, maintaining strong relationships with peers and management outside of the department
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, etc.); Web proficiency.
  • Ability to travel 5% of the time
  • Ability to clear required background check

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in Python, Perl, Shell Scripting, JAVA, Ruby
  • Experience testing internationalized systems
  • Experience testing for 508 compliance or other relevant accessibility compliances
  • Experience working with an offshore or remote team

raw.description:
🚀 We’re Growing Our Research Dream Team!

Titles? Meh, we’re not big on them, but let’s call this one R&D&I Project Manager. 😉

As part of our R&D&I team, you’ll play a key role in identifying, preparing, managing and justifying competitive funding opportunities for innovative technology projects — especially in the fields of Artificial Intelligence and 3D. You’ll work closely with technical teams, public administrations, partners and stakeholders to turn bold ideas into real funded projects.

Here’s the deal:

You’ll help us transform cutting-edge ideas into competitive R&D&I proposals.

  • You’ll work on projects connected to some of today’s most exciting tech areas: AI, 3D and advanced TIC solutions.
  • You’ll collaborate with highly technical teams who love building things from scratch.
  • You’ll be involved in national and European funding opportunities, public calls and innovation ecosystems.
  • AGILE isn’t just a buzzword here — it’s how we roll. Multidisciplinary teams? Check. Ownership? Double check.

Ready to help us take innovation one step further? Let’s make it happen! 😊

You will be responsible for:

  • Writing technical proposals related to Artificial Intelligence and 3D.
  • Managing administrative procedures with public administrations to secure regional, national and European R&D&I funding.
  • Preparing technical and financial justifications for managed proposals.

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Huntsville, Alabama

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

You know Bitrefill, you've probably routed a payment through us. You get why Lightning matters and you want to build the infrastructure that makes it work for a million+ customers across 180 countries. If that's you, hit the apply button and let's talk.

If you need more info to decide, keep reading. We kept the corporate fluff out, so it won't take long.

About the role

Bitcoin and Lightning are where Bitrefill comes from, and they're still core to what we do. There's more happening in this space than the team can keep up with, so we're bringing in more hands to keep things running and push them forward: shipping the integrations we keep talking about, digging into how our payments actually flow, and turning "we should really do this" into things that are live.

Our Tech Stack

  • Node.js / TypeScript

  • Python

  • MongoDB, MySQL, Typesense

  • Amazon AWS, Kubernetes

What you'll do

  • Own and improve our Lightning Network and Bitcoin payment infrastructure, from everyday upgrades and fixes to to larger improvements across the stack

  • Work hands-on with Lightning implementations (LND, CLN, or similar), payment channels, and liquidity management

  • Analyze how our Lightning payments flow, including forensic work after incidents, and build monitoring and policies on top

  • Strengthen the security of our crypto systems: key management, HSMs, and how we safeguard funds

  • Help us get crypto transaction accounting right, working with the finance team so our books reflect how Bitcoin actually moves

  • Evaluate and integrate new Bitcoin and Lightning tech as the space evolves

  • Get new payment protocols into production, from payjoin to nostr-based flows

  • Build the Lightning side of our agentic commerce work

  • Ship with product and design, and contribute to our internal libraries and open-source tooling

What we're looking for

  • Several years building software professionally, with a track record of shipping real things

  • AI is part of how you build (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar). This is non-negotiable for us

  • Deep understanding of the Lightning Network protocol and Bitcoin fundamentals

  • Hands-on experience with at least one Lightning implementation (LND, CLN, Eclair, or LDK)

  • Strong with our backend stack, Node.js and TypeScript, and comfortable working in Python

  • Crypto-native. You use it, you follow where it's headed, and nobody needs to explain Bitcoin to you

  • Self-driven. You spot the opportunity and push it forward instead of waiting for a roadmap

Bonus points

  • You've contributed to open-source Lightning or Bitcoin projects

  • Experience with payment channel management and liquidity optimization

  • You run your own node

  • Hands-on with newer Lightning and Layer 2 tech

  • Experience building payments at scale

Why Bitrefill

We've been quietly right about something since 2014: internet money should just work. Fully remote since day one. Team across 30+ countries. Get paid in crypto if you want. No bullshit meetings. Twice a year we meet up to build together in person. The rest of the time: work hard, get shit done.

raw.description:
Salesforce Integration Architect – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Salesforce Integration Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the end-to-end integration architecture for Salesforce ecosystems spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, and Industry Clouds.
  • Select and apply appropriate integration patterns including request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, and event-driven approaches.
  • Design integrations using Salesforce-native capabilities (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Connect, Composite APIs) alongside enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Lead integration design reviews and approve technical designs across Salesforce programs.
  • Define API strategy, contract management, and versioning standards for Salesforce-related integrations.
  • Architect data synchronization patterns for high-volume integrations with ERP, billing, and operational systems.
  • Design identity and access patterns for Salesforce integrations including OAuth flows and connected app management.
  • Establish error handling, retry, and dead-letter strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management for integration-heavy Salesforce implementations, designing patterns that stay safely within platform limits even as transaction volumes grow over time.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure integrations meet enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Collaborate closely with vendors to evaluate and onboard integration platforms, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce integration capabilities and broader iPaaS evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce integration programs.
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
  • Experience with event-driven integration platforms (Kafka, Solace, Confluent).
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds and their data-integration nuances.
  • Exposure to high-volume integration scenarios (10M+ records/day).
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to hilda@bvteck.com. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

The Vendor Relationship Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing a network of vendor providers that support business operations and strategic initiatives. This role serves as a key point of contact for vendor relationships, helping align vendor capabilities with organizational needs and business priorities. The Vendor Relationship Manager supports vendor engagement, relationship management, performance monitoring, risk identification, and continuous improvement efforts to ensure the organization maintains access to effective and reliable vendor support. Operating with a degree of independence, this position focuses on building productive partnerships, supporting business objectives, and contributing to the overall effectiveness of the vendor network.

  • Manage key vendor relationships across an assigned portfolio of external service providers.

  • Maintain effective relationships with vendor contacts and internal stakeholders.
  • Serve as a point of contact for vendor-related discussions, planning, and relationship management.
  • Monitor the overall health, capacity, and effectiveness of the vendor network.
  • Identify vendor-related risks, service gaps, and opportunities to strengthen support for business operations.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and business leaders to support operational and strategic initiatives.
  • Participate in customer-facing discussions when vendor input or subject matter expertise is needed.
  • Support vendor growth and expansion initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Required Education, Experience, Certification/Licensure

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 5+ years of experience with commercial title work as searcher/abstractor or examiner.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

  • Strong negotiation, influence and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal, relationship-building and teamwork skills
  • Self-motivated; self-starter
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, respond quickly to emergent problems, and focus both on long-range projects and immediate tasks
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. Overview

Paralegal – Licensing & Regulatory (Healthcare) | Fully Remote (ET Preferred)

At Groups, we are redefining access to high-quality treatment for substance use disorders, and our ability to operate across multiple states depends on strong, precise regulatory execution. We are looking for a detail-oriented Paralegal – Licensing & Regulatory who thrives in a fast-paced, highly regulated healthcare environment and wants to play a critical role in keeping our operations compliant, licensed, and growing.

In this Paralegal role, you will own the lifecycle of licensing and regulatory processes across multiple states, partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Executive Leadership. If you enjoy managing complex requirements, staying ahead of regulatory changes, and bringing structure to ambiguity, this is an opportunity to make a real impact in a mission-driven organization.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do• Own end-to-end licensing for substance use disorder treatment facilities across multiple states.• Prepare, submit, track, and maintain applications, renewals, and supporting documentation.• Manage licensing calendars, deadlines, and compliance tracking with precision.• Serve as a key liaison with state and federal agencies to resolve issues and move applications forward.• Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, Legal, HR, and Finance to gather and validate required information.• Support accreditations and registrations (DEA, CMS, CLIA, and others).• Maintain organized, audit-ready records for all licenses, permits, and regulatory documentation.• Monitor and summarize regulatory changes and proactively flag risks or impacts.

Expanded Legal & Compliance Exposure• Assist with healthcare regulatory matters (HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, Stark, Anti-Kickback, EKRA, telehealth requirements).• Support contract drafting and review (NDAs, vendor agreements, BAAs, employment agreements).• Conduct legal and regulatory research.• Assist with subpoenas, audits, and litigation-related documentation.

Qualifications

What You Bring• 2–3+ years of experience in a paralegal, licensing, or regulatory role.• Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated industry (behavioral health strongly preferred).• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and jurisdictions simultaneously.• Exceptional attention to detail and documentation accuracy.• Clear, professional communication skills for agency and cross-functional collaboration.• Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable steps.

Preferred Qualifications• Paralegal certificate or degree in Legal Studies, Healthcare Administration, or related field.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, in Paralegal studies, Legal studies, Healthcare Administration or Regulatory affairs.• Experience with state licensing boards, DEA registrations, or controlled substance regulations.• Prior experience in healthcare, especially behavioral health, strongly preferred.

Work Environment• Fully remote (Eastern Time Zone strongly preferred for team alignment).• Must have reliable high-speed internet (minimum 50 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload).

Why Join Groups?• Mission-driven work that directly supports life-saving treatment access.• High visibility and collaboration with executive leadership.• Opportunity to build and streamline multi-state regulatory processes.• A growing organization where your work directly enables expansion and outcomes.

Groups is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Please note: This role is not available to residents of AK, AR, CA, HI, ID, MD, NE, SD, UT, or WY.
