Objectif principal du rôle

Gérer, superviser et représenter les besoins de l'équipe en s'appuyant sur un processus de développement bien établi et un travail pratique et personnel sur les niveaux, le contenu et la documentation, afin de produire efficacement des niveaux jouables conformes à la vision du directeur artistique, aux exigences de conception des niveaux et aux besoins narratifs, tout en respectant les contraintes de production et les critères de performance.

Responsabilités

Direction

  • Diriger une équipe et favoriser un climat de travail stimulant au sein de son équipe afin d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles pour le projet et de favoriser le développement personnel des membres de l'équipe.

Maintenir la direction artistique et la qualité

  • Création d'une géométrie et d'une composition d'univers pour les niveaux dans Unreal Engine.
  • Veiller à la cohérence technique de l'ensemble des éléments graphiques d'environnement dans le cadre du projet, en respectant le process établi.
  • S'assurer que tous les éléments créés répondent efficacement à l'ensemble des exigences techniques du moteur et de conception.
  • Définir, maintenir et communiquer les normes de qualité et les critères d'achèvement relatifs aux éléments graphiques d'environnement.
  • Traduire la vision du directeur artistique en une direction artistique claire pour l'équipe et veiller à sa mise en application cohérente.

Production/Délais

  • Réaliser les tâches conformément aux spécifications et assurer le bon déroulement des processus de travail dans le respect des délais impartis.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de production sur la répartition des tâches et le calendrier afin de respecter les délais, tout en veillant à un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à la définition claire des attentes et du cadre de travail.
  • Superviser la correction des bogues et rédiger des études de cas de recherche et développement dans la base de connaissances.
  • Identifier les risques et les communiquer dès que possible, et proposer des solutions pour les gérer en fonction des besoins du projet.

Retour d’information

  • Fournir un retour d'information quotidien afin de maintenir le niveau de qualité souhaité et de favoriser le développement de l'équipe.
  • Travailler avec l'équipe pour trouver des solutions et résoudre les problèmes de manière créative.

Collaboration/communication

  • Partage des connaissances et mentorat des collègues.
  • Collaborer avec l'équipe d’art technique et encourager les initiatives de recherche et développement afin d'explorer de nouvelles techniques et d'apporter des améliorations aux flux de travail et aux processus.
  • Collaborer et communiquer efficacement avec les autres gestionnaires, directeurs et parties prenantes des projets, tous les services confondus, afin de garantir l'efficacité et de minimiser les malentendus.
  • Réaliser régulièrement des évaluations des performances et des rémunérations des membres de l'équipe.
  • Mener à bien des projets de recrutement en collaboration avec les RH.
  • Assurer l'intégration des nouvelles recrues.


Main goal of the role

To manage, oversee and represent team needs supported by established pipeline execution and hands-on personal work on levels, content and documentation to effectively produce playable levels based on Art directors vision, Level design and storytelling needs with respecting production constraints and performance benchmarks.

Duties

Leadership

  • Lead a team and foster an engaging atmosphere within their team to achieve best possible result for the project and personal growth of team members.

Maintain artistic direction and quality

  • Creating world geometry and composition for levels in Unreal Engine.
  • Maintain technical consistency of all environment art within scope and following established pipeline.
  • Ensure that all created assets efficiently satisfy all technical engine and design requirements.
  • Define, maintain and communicate environment art quality standards and completion criteria for environment deliverables.
  • Translate the Art Director's vision into clear artistic direction for the team and ensure its consistent execution.

Production/Deadline

  • Produce work within specifications and maintain workflow pipelines within given deadlines.
  • Work closely with the production team on tasks assignment and schedule to meet deadlines, also ensuring healthy work-life balance by setting clear expectations and scope of work.
  • Supervision of bug fixing and describing R&D case studies in knowledge base.
  • Risk identification and communication at possibly early stage and propose solutions to manage risk along project needs.

Feedback

  • Provide day-to-day feedback to maintain desired quality and team growth.
  • Working with the team to find solutions and creatively solve problems.

Collaboration/communication

  • Knowledge sharing and mentoring peers.
  • Collaborate with Tech Art and foster R&D initiatives, to explore new techniques and implement improvements to pipelines and workflows.
  • Collaborates and communicates effectively across departments with other Leads, Directors, and project stakeholders to ensure efficiency and minimize miscommunication.
  • Conduct consistent performance and compensation reviews of staff members.
  • Conduct recruitment projects with HR collaboration.
  • Conduct onboarding to new hires.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Portfolio présentant des créations d'environnements de qualité AAA, mettant idéalement en avant des analyses détaillées d'une approche modulaire des flux de travail, illustrant une solide connaissance du domaine, une expérience étendue des pipelines, un sens artistique développé et la capacité à produire des environnements adaptés à la production de jeux vidéo (Unreal Engine).
  • Expérience professionnelle avec au moins un logiciel de création numérique de référence (Maya, Blender, 3ds Max ou équivalent).
  • Maîtrise des flux de travail modulaires.
  • Expérience approfondie dans la création d’environnements sous Unreal Engine, notamment la conception de mondes et l’optimisation.
  • Interpréter artistiquement des concepts ou aller au-delà de l'idée initiale de manière créative.
  • Capacité à s'adapter et à développer un style artistique, des techniques et des processus de travail spécifiques avec un minimum d'accompagnement.
  • Démonstration de la mise en scène narrative.
  • Adaptive.
  • Compétences pour trouver le juste équilibre entre la qualité artistique et les performances au sein du moteur de jeu.
  • Solide maîtrise des techniques artistiques traditionnelles, ainsi que des compétences fondamentales en conception (forme, texture, valeur et couleur).
  • Maîtrise de l'utilisation des shaders de rendu basé sur la physique et des cartes normales au quotidien.
  • Excellentes compétences en matière de mentorat, d'accompagnement et de direction.
  • Esprit de collaboration avec les gestionnaires de service et les différents départements pour relever les défis artistiques et techniques.

Logiciel

Unreal Engine, Maya/3dsMax, Zbrush, Blender, Photoshop, Substance Painter

Expérience

Au moins 7 ans d'expérience dans le développement de jeux sur console ou PC, dont au moins 5 ans avec Unreal Engine, et une expérience préalable à un poste d'encadrement.

Must have qualifications

  • Portfolio demonstrating AAA quality environment art, ideally showcasing breakdowns of modular workflow approach explaining strong domain knowledge, broader pipeline experience, artistic taste and the ability to deliver environments suitable for game production (Unreal Engine).
  • Professional experience with at least one industry-standard DCC package (Maya, Blender, 3ds Max or equivalent).
  • Mastery of modular workflows.
  • Advanced experience creating environments in Unreal Engine, including world building and optimization.
  • Artistically interpret concepts or creatively push beyond an initial ideation.
  • Ability to adapt, and develop specific art style, techniques and workflows with minimum guidance.
  • Demonstration of narrative set dressing.Adaptive.
  • Skilled at balancing art quality and performance in the game engine.
  • A solid understanding of traditional art skills along with foundational design competencies (shape, form, texture, value and color).
  • Skilled in using PBR shaders and normal maps on a daily basis.
  • Strong mentoring, coaching and leadership skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with department leads, and different departments to solve artistic and technical challenges.

Software

Unreal Engine, Maya/3dsMax, Zbrush, Blender, Photoshop, Substance Painter

Experience

7+ years in console or PC game development including 5+ years in unreal engine and prior experience in any leadership capacity.

​​​​

Ce que nous offrons:

  • Un ensemble d’avantages sociaux payés à 100 % par PCF. La compagnie d’assurance rembourse les réclamations à 100 % (jusqu’à 1000 $ de services par année, en plus d’une couverture familiale ou individuelle).
  • Une couverture dentaire complète, y compris les soins dentaires.
  • La cotisation égale au REER à hauteur de 4 % avant déductions fiscales, 100 % acquis dès le premier jour.
  • Une semaine de congé payé pendant les vacances d’hiver.
  • 20 jours de congé payé et 5 jours de congé de maladie payé.
  • Des séances gratuites de soins virtuels de santé et de bien-être mental, incluses dans le régime pour les membres et leurs personnes à charge.
  • Des occasions de développement personnel et la possibilité d’œuvrer dans un environnement mondial.
  • L’occasion de travailler au sein d’une équipe créative avec des personnes passionnées par ce qu’elles font.

What we offer:

  • Benefit package 100% paid by PCF. The insurance company reimburses 100% of claims (Up to $1000 per service a year, as well as individual family coverage).
  • Full Dental coverage, including major dental.
  • 4% RRSP matching before tax deductions, 100% vested on day 1.
  • Paid week off during Winter Holidays.
  • 20 paid vacation days and 5 paid sick days.
  • Free virtual health and mental well-being sessions are included in the plan for members and their dependents.
  • Personal development opportunities and ability to work in a global environment.
  • Work in a creative team with people full of passion for what they do.

People Can Fly est l'un des principaux studios indépendants de développement de jeux AAA. Notre équipe internationale est composée de centaines de personnes talentueuses qui travaillent dans nos bureaux en Pologne, au Royaume-Uni, en Irlande, aux États-Unis et au Canada, ainsi qu'à distance dans le monde entier.

Fondée en 2002, notre société s'est imposée dans le genre des jeux de tir avec des titres tels que Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgement and Outriders. En tant que l'un des studios les plus chevronnés dans l'utilisation du moteur Unreal Engine, nous continuons à développer notre expertise et à dépasser les limites du possible dans le domaine du développement de jeux vidéo.

Nos équipes créatives travaillent actuellement sur plusieurs titres captivants : Gears of War: E-Day développé en collaboration avec Microsoft: projet Echo pour KRAFTON; et Lost Rift, une propriété intellectuelle originale que nous développons en interne selon notre modèle d'auto-édition. Nous explorons également de nouvelles plateformes et expériences avec la réalité virtuelle et d'autres projets non annoncés.

Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience, PCF continue d'explorer de nouveaux horizons. Notre objectif est de combiner notre expertise avec la créativité des talents les plus brillants et les plus avant-gardistes du secteur, afin de créer la prochaine génération de jeux d'action pour les joueurs du monde entier.

Si vous nous rejoignez dans cette aventure, vous aurez la chance de perfectionner votre art, d'élargir vos connaissances et de travailler aux côtés des meilleurs du marché afin de créer des expériences uniques et inoubliables pour les joueurs du monde entier.

People Can Fly is one of the leading independent AAA game development studios. Our international team consists of hundreds of talented individuals working from offices in Poland, the UK, Ireland, the US, and Canada, as well as remotely across the globe.

Founded in 2002, we made our mark on the shooter genre with titles such as Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, and Outriders. As one of the most experienced Unreal Engine studios in the industry, we continue to expand on our expertise and push the boundaries of what’s possible in game development.

Our creative teams are currently working on several exciting titles: Gears of War: E-Day developed in collaboration with Microsoft; Project Echo for KRAFTON; and Lost Rift, an original IP we are developing in-house under our self-publishing model. We are also exploring new platforms and experiences with VR and other unannounced projects.

With over 20 years of experience, PCF continues to explore new horizons. We aim to combine our expertise with the creativity of the best and most forward-thinking talent in the industry, building the next generation of action games for players worldwide.

If you join us on this journey, you’ll have the chance to perfect your craft, expand your knowledge, and work alongside industry leaders to create unique, unforgettable experiences for gamers everywhere.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who owns the technical strategy and platform evolution behind a key product line — someone who thinks in platforms rather than features, operates with AI tools as core infrastructure, and translates deep technical work into clear business impact.


This role sits at the interface of Product and Engineering. You will own the technical roadmap for your area — new capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt, security, and scaling — and keep Architecture and Engineering aligned with the business-facing teams that depend on them. You should already be using AI to accelerate your own work, be comfortable reading architecture diagrams and reviewing API designs, and bring strong opinions about how SaaS platforms should be designed, measured, and scaled. Your work will help our customers reach their goals and drive Momentive’s growth forward.


This position reports to the Director of Product Management. This is a remote, US-based position.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create, own, and maintain the technical product roadmap for your area — spanning new features and capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt remediation, security fixes, and scaling mechanisms.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of the platform architecture and how it interacts with product use cases, the broader Momentive portfolio, and third-party integrations.
  • Translate product-line needs and stakeholder input into clear technical requirements, initiatives, and epics for Engineering — identifying shared patterns and consolidating duplicated efforts into scalable, reusable capabilities.
  • Maintain alignment between Architecture/Engineering teams and Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and other non-R&D functions — translating complex platform decisions into clear business-impact narratives.
  • Work with Support to triage and prioritize operational issues impacting customers and the broader platform.
  • Drive Product/Architecture interface process improvement, ensuring clean handoffs and shared accountability across teams.
  • Monitor platform adoption, usage, performance, and reliability metrics, and use data to drive technical investment decisions.
  • Act as Product Owner when needed, operating with high autonomy in a role where success depends on influence across teams you do not directly control.
  • Use AI tools as core tools in your daily work — not as novelties, but as force multipliers for research, analysis, communication, and decision-making:
  • Use AI to prototype technical approaches, analyze cross-product usage data, and generate first-draft technical specifications and requirements that you then refine with engineering judgment.
  • Compress discovery and analysis cycles by using AI to synthesize stakeholder input, assess existing systems and data flows, and surface insights that would otherwise take weeks.
  • Stay current on AI tooling and platform patterns, and share effective approaches with the broader product and engineering organization.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent work experience; 5+ years in a software/SaaS environment, including 4+ years in a product management role.
  • Advanced technical understanding of networking, databases, operating systems, APIs, microservices, and cloud infrastructure — with the depth to read architecture diagrams, review API designs, and engage in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
  • Experience defining APIs, data contracts, and integration approaches, and managing platform or system migrations while maintaining continuity for dependent teams and customers.
  • Advanced understanding of Agile processes and deployment methodologies, including CI/CD; strong grasp of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated, meaningful use of AI tools in your own workflow. You should be able to speak concretely to how AI has changed the way you work, what it’s replaced, and where you’ve found its limits.
  • Ability to derive and apply technical product strategy across one or more products on a 6–12 month time horizon, grounded in strong market and portfolio analysis.
  • Experience with secure coding, compliance, and security practices.
  • Strong experience with Jira and metrics tracking for optimal team output.
  • Experience working with Associations and/or Nonprofits is a plus.

Ideal Candidate Attributes:

  • Platform Thinker: Thinks in systems rather than features — building capabilities that scale across products and serve multiple teams through a shared core.
  • Technically Fluent: Comfortable in deep technical discussions with engineers, and able to translate complex architecture into clear narratives for leadership, product peers, and GTM teams.
  • Outcome-Focused: Draws a clear line from technical decisions to customer success and business results, and uses data to drive investment and prioritization.
  • Influential Leader: Drives outcomes across teams they do not directly control, building alignment and shared accountability through influence.
  • AI-Native: Treats AI as a core part of the job, not a novelty. Uses it daily to prototype, analyze, and communicate, and shares what works with the team.
  • Owner: Demonstrates significant initiative and end-to-end ownership, with an uncompromising commitment to product quality, reliability, performance, and scalability.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

What We Offer:

  • Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.
  • Customized training programs to help you advance your career.
  • Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Channel Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As the North Region Channel Development Manager, you will drive the development and execution of a highly effective sales channel strategy for the North regional market to improve ABB’s market penetration and achieve its growth objectives. Each day, you will plan and ensure the execution of the business area/division sales strategy to achieve both qualitative and quantitative targets for the assigned channel in a profitable way with a focus on orders, revenues, growth, margin, market share, sales productivity, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by leading, developing, and coaching the related Channel Sales organization.


While this is a remote position, preference is for candidates located in the following metro areas: Indianapolis, IN, Chicago, IL, or Detroit, MI.

This role is contributing to the growth of ABB's Service business in the North Region (specifically Midwest states).

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining and implementing the North Region channel sales strategy, in accordance with the marketing and sales strategy and ensuring regular follow-up to achieve them.

  • Implementing annual performance assessments and forecast processes for channel partners.

  • Ensuring appropriate communication, promotion, and training activities are in place for our channel partners.

  • Identifying, developing, and owning the channel partner relationships to meet current and future sales growth strategy.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years of channel sales experience, OR, HS Diploma and 8+ years of experience.

  • Proven success in driving channel growth through innovative distributor planning required. Experience in services sales preferred.

  • Experience using tools like Microsoft Suite, Salesforce, and Power BI.

  • Ability to effectively communicate, drive mindshare and influence both internal teams and external partners.

  • Ability to travel on average 50% or as needed

  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

More about us:

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

What's in it for you:

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

  • Be part of a collaborative, non-siloed team environment
  • Clear mentorship and career progression path

Compensation & Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) / Roth 401(k) with firm support
  • Industry-leading parental leave & family benefits
  • Wellness programs (including mental health support & apps)

See what makes this opportunity unique — watch a quick overview video. Job Preview Video

Ready to make a difference right from your home office?

At Carenet Health, we turn everyday conversations into meaningful connections that help people take charge of their health.

As an Engagement Specialist, you’ll spend your day reaching out to health plan members, guiding them toward scheduling their care assessments, and giving them the encouragement they need to take that next step. Some calls will be easy wins; others will take a little more heart. Either way — you’ll be the reason someone gets the care they deserve.

Responsibilities

  • Engage and Educate: Make outbound calls to patients, members, and customers to discuss healthcare needs, benefits, and in-home or virtual healthcare evaluations
  • Bring a Sales-Minded Approach: Approach each interaction with a friendly and welcoming tone, building genuine rapport while presenting the value of the healthcare program in a way that resonates with the member’s needs – while being intentional in addressing hesitations to build trust and drive engagement
  • Turn Opportunities into Wins: Build meaningful rapport with customers, clearly explain the healthcare program, and manage resistance by addressing concerns and highlighting benefits, maximizing the value of every interaction to convert each opportunity into a successful outcome
  • Make an Impact: Help members set meaningful healthcare goals and guide them toward achieving them by clearly educating them on the program’s advantages, proactively addressing hesitations, and reinforcing the value of taking action
  • Be a Problem-Solver: Identify, research, and resolve potential issues while delivering exceptional customer service, proactively highlighting the program’s benefits as part of the solution to build confidence and drive engagement
  • Promote Healthcare Benefits: Address member concerns with empathy and senior sensitivity, ensuring that conversations are value-driven and solution-oriented
  • Embrace the Service Plus Mindset: Resolve customer concerns effectively, anticipate future needs, and deliver proactive support to enhance their experience
  • Stay Goal-Oriented: Achieve productivity targets while demonstrating a strong work ethic, motivation, and commitment to making every interaction a success
  • Adapt and Adjust: Reset appointments and schedules as needed to meet customer needs and expectations

Qualifications

We Want You to Be Successful

Here’s what helps you thrive in this role:

  • High School Diploma or GED (required and verified during background check)

  • Strong computer skills — data entry, screen navigation, and solid keyboarding speed

  • Experience using Microsoft Outlook and Word

  • Excellent customer service skills and a friendly, compassionate tone

  • Ability to stick to schedules and daily tasks

  • Great oral and written communication skills

  • Genuine empathy and care for others

  • Must have two monitors (minimum 22 inches each) with both HDMI and DisplayPort connections ready prior to your start date.

Compensation & Benefits

At Carenet Health, we truly value the expertise and dedication of our team members — and we show it through a competitive and supportive package:

Pay: $15.00 per hour

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) plan with company match

  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)

  • Employee wellness programs

  • Career development and growth opportunities

Additional Information

  • Completion of assessments may be required before moving forward in the hiring process.

  • Assessments must be completed independently — any unauthorized completion (during or after the process) will result in disqualification or termination.

If you’re ready to bring empathy, energy, and genuine care to every call — we’d love to have you on our team.

Join Carenet Health and make every conversation count.

Carenet Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please note that we are not accepting resumes for this position from external staffing agencies or recruiters. To be considered for this role, please submit your application directly through our official career portal.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

At Carenet Healthcare, we are committed to the safety and trust of all potential job candidates. Please be mindful about any potential scam, offering false employment opportunities and issuing fake offer letters.

Carenet communicates using our e-mail domain: @carenethealth.com

To report suspicious job ads or emails, email our recruiting team at recruiting@carenethealth.com and include as much detail as possible (e.g., job board where the false ad was placed, documentation that will assist us in the investigation).

If you believe you have been a victim of a crime, contact the local authorities or the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center at ic3.gov.

For more information on job scams, visit the Federal Trade Commission at https://www.consumer.ftc.gov/articles/0243-job-scams.

Job Title: Senior D365 CRM Architect

Location: Remote

Job Summary:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior D365 CRM Architect to lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE (Customer Engagement) solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Dynamics 365 CRM modules, Power Platform, and Azure integration, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade CRM solutions that align with strategic business goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead architect for D365 CRM implementations, upgrades, and integrations
  • Design scalable, secure, and performance-optimized D365 CE solutions across Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service modules.
  • Translate complex business requirements into robust architectural designs and solution blueprints.
  • Oversee solution configuration, customizations (including plugins, workflows, Power Automate), and data migrations.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to delivery teams including developers, consultants, and testers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, business units, and external vendors.
  • Drive governance around D365 customizations and Power Platform components.
  • Ensure adherence to Microsoft best practices and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Lead performance tuning, code reviews, and quality assurance efforts.
  • Stay current on D365 roadmap and recommend new capabilities where appropriate.
  • Working with leadership to budget a project
  • Pre-sales experience (ideally if we can find someone with some that would be ideal, but willing to upskill and train if have the acumen).

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM / D365 CE, including multiple full-cycle implementations.
  • Strong understanding of Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse).
  • Expertise in data modeling, integrations (Azure Logic Apps, APIs), and security models in D365.
  • Hands-on experience with Dynamics SDK, JavaScript, C#, and custom plugin development.
  • Experience with CI/CD for D365 using Azure DevOps.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or equivalent certifications.
  • Experience integrating with ERP systems (e.g., Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations).
  • Knowledge of Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, Omnichannel, or Voice of the Customer.
  • Background in industries such as finance, healthcare, or public sector is a plus.

The base salary for this position is $$106,087- 166,709 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

The deadline to apply for this position is: 07/29/2026. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

Overview

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

Position Summary:

As a Staff Test Engineer, you will take ownership of the TE strategy for larger and more complex software projects, working closely with development, product, and engineering teams. You will design and implement robust test plans, develop and maintain automated test scripts, and drive continuous improvement in testing processes and maximizing testing efficiency through automation. Your deep technical expertise will help optimize test frameworks, mentoring senior engineers while ensuring high levels of test coverage and quality assurance across products. You will play a critical role in ensuring product quality and stability through proactive risk management and process improvements.

Geo-Salary Information

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$94,458 to $179,048 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$85,871 to $162,771 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$77,3283 to $146,494 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

In CA: Typical hiring range is $123,078 to $170,941

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Develop Test Plans and Strategies: With the goal of minimizing production defects, lead the creation and execution of high-level test strategies for complex projects. Ensure that all test plans align with business objectives and deliver comprehensive test coverage. Drive the adoption of an automation-first approach for large sized feature and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and Execute Test Cases: Take ownership of designing and executing high-complexity cross-functional test cases that cover a range of testing types. Develop and manage comprehensive testing strategies across large-scale projects, ensuring alignment with overall development and business goals.
  • Perform Manual and Automated Testing: With the goal of minimizing production defects, lead both manual and automated testing efforts in a medium sized functional area, focusing on improving automation coverage. Take ownership of automation strategy and ensure automation components are scalable and maintainable.
  • Documentations for Process and Bug Report: Identify complex defects and provide detailed analysis in bug report. Enforce defect tracking, progress updates, timely resolution and effective communication across teams. Implement defect management best practices and ensure overall quality. Lead quality initiatives to ensure defects are minimized in future releases. Establish and lead best practices for maintaining test documentation across upstream and downstream functional areas.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to ensure complex requirement's clarity including upstream and downstream functional areas, accountable for all features meeting quality standards and ensure software meets requirements across the product.
  • Continuous Improvement: Implement and Drive Continuous Improvement Practices. Lead small process improvement initiatives across medium sized features . raw.description:
Position Summary

Leads the complete delivery of the FAA OBIWAN System Maintenance task order and serves as the primary contractor interface to the FAA Contracting Officer, Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), ABP-330 Program Office, and other authorized stakeholders. The Program Manager is accountable for program control, staffing, schedule, quality, risk, financial performance, transition, customer communications, deliverables, and coordinated execution across software, database, integration, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and user-support workstreams.

The candidate must have the ability to operate effectively under pressure adhering to the ProSol Core Values of Agility: rapid adaptation to the changing requirements and environment of our clients; Excellence:Service quality that exceeds the expectations of our clients; Integrity: Accountability and honesty−always doing the right thing; and Long-Term Commitment: Unquestioned loyalty and dedication to our clients, partners and employees.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain the formal program organization, governance structure, decision authorities, communications plan, and management controls required to execute all contract tasks.
  • Serve as the primary interface with the FAA and ensure that technical direction, priorities, and requests remain within the authorized contract scope; promptly elevate potential changes affecting scope, cost, schedule, or performance.
  • Develop, submit, maintain, and obtain approval of the Project Management Plan (PMP), including the work breakdown structure, integrated schedule, milestones, dependencies, staffing plan, resource allocation, risk approach, performance metrics, quality controls, and rationale for project organization.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules and delivery calendars; monitor progress, identify potential delays, adjust resources, and ensure schedule changes and deliverable dependencies are controlled and communicated.
  • Lead contract transition activities, including the Kick-Off, staffing phase-in, incumbent coordination, knowledge transfer, Government-furnished property inventory, continuity planning, transition metrics, and transition-out planning.
  • Prepare and submit accurate Monthly Status Reports that address accomplishments, work in progress, planned activities, hours by task/labor category/personnel, deliverable status, staffing, subcontractor status, risks, corrective actions, action items, and financial performance.
  • Plan and conduct monthly Program Management Reviews; deliver customer-ready briefing materials before each meeting and accurate minutes, action items, issues, decisions, and resolutions afterward within required timeframes.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Control Plan; ensure peer reviews, test traceability, acceptance criteria, performance measurement, audits, defect prevention, corrective actions, and continuous improvement are executed across the team.
  • Maintain an active risk and issue register; lead root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action when performance, schedule, security, quality, staffing, or service-level risks emerge.
  • Manage staffing, workload distribution, employee performance, subcontractor performance, coverage, succession planning, retention, cross-training, and backup assignments to sustain uninterrupted operations.
  • Monitor firm-fixed-price performance, labor utilization, budgets, funding, deliverable acceptance, and cost control; provide timely internal and customer reporting without compromising contract compliance.
  • Integrate Agile/DevSecOps delivery, configuration management, release management, database/infrastructure operations, security compliance, and service management into one coordinated operating model.
  • Ensure the team provides the early-morning data-load/reconciliation coverage, proactive monitoring, production-release support, and incident response required by the OBIWAN mission.
  • Enforce compliance with FAA security, privacy, Public Trust, records-management, accessibility, acceptable-use, supply-chain, non-public information, and Government-property requirements.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready program records, decisions, approvals, meeting documentation, deliverable versions, performance evidence, and correspondence.

Required Technical and Professional Competencies

  • Advanced program and project management knowledge for federal information-technology operations and maintenance programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary teams supporting enterprise applications, Oracle technologies, data integration, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and user services.
  • Strong command of integrated scheduling, risk management, quality assurance, financial tracking, staffing management, performance measurement, and customer reporting.
  • Working knowledge of Agile development, FAA-style SDLC controls, DevOps/DevSecOps, configuration management, release management, IT service management, and cybersecurity governance.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive briefings, plans, status reports, minutes, corrective-action plans, and customer correspondence.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment, prioritize competing mission demands, resolve ambiguity, and make timely decisions within contract authority.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with Government personnel, corporate support functions, subcontractors, technical specialists, and geographically dispersed users.

Minimum Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, project management, or a related field; directly relevant experience may substitute for a portion of formal education.
  • At least eight years of progressively responsible experience managing IT operations, enterprise application sustainment, systems integration, or comparable federal programs.
  • At least three years of experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and managing performance, staffing, quality, risk, schedule, and customer communications.
  • Experience delivering recurring program-management plans, schedules, status reports, financial reports, program reviews, quality-control activities, and transition deliverables.
  • Experience managing fixed-price service delivery and subcontractor or teammate performance is strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent program-management credential.
  • Prior FAA, Department of Transportation, or federal financial-systems experience.
  • Experience with Oracle analytics, Oracle databases, enterprise data integration, ServiceNow, JIRA, Git, Jenkins, or comparable tools.
  • Experience managing CMMI-aligned processes, Authority to Operate (ATO) sustainment, NIST-based security compliance, and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) activities.
  • Experience leading incumbent transitions and maintaining uninterrupted operations during contract changeover.

Certifications

No certification is contractually mandated. PMP, PgMP, ITIL, CSM, SAFe, or comparable credentials are preferred when supported by relevant experience.

Core Competencies

• Program leadership and accountability

• Federal customer management

• Integrated planning and scheduling

• Risk and issue management

• Quality and performance control

• Financial and staffing management

• Clear executive communication

• Team development and cross-training

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position directly supervises or functionally leads the OBIWAN technical team and may oversee subcontractor personnel. The Program Manager assigns work, evaluates performance, coordinates training and cross-coverage, and recommends personnel actions consistent with ProSol policy.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

Work is primarily performed in a remote office or Contractor facility using Government-furnished and company-provided technology. The position requires extended computer use, frequent virtual meetings, sustained attention to detailed technical and financial information, and occasional work outside normal hours. Travel may be required when pre-approved. The employee must be able to communicate effectively by telephone, video conference, and written media.

Performance Expectations

  • All contractual deliverables are complete, accurate, timely, approved, and traceable to contract requirements.
  • Program risks, staffing gaps, quality issues, and schedule threats are identified early and addressed through documented corrective action.
  • Technical and user-support services remain stable, secure, responsive, and continuously staffed.
  • FAA stakeholders receive clear, accurate, and proactive communications with no unauthorized commitments or scope changes.
  • The team maintains Public Trust eligibility, required access, training compliance, documentation quality, and audit readiness.

Position Description Disclaimer

This description summarizes the position’s primary duties and may be revised for related business or contract needs. It does not create an employment contract. Reasonable accommodations may be provided in accordance with applicable law and company policy.

Additional Information

ProSol is an equal opportunity employer, all interested qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, EEO/D/M/V/F. ProSol welcomes and encourages diversity in the workforce. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Mobile App Developers (React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to join the Tendem project (https://tendem.ai/) and build native and cross-platform mobile applications within our hybrid AI + human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot – that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift – you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide mobile engineering expertise, platform-specific judgment, and quality control to ensure apps are stable, performant, and ready for real users on real devices. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience shipping iOS and/or Android apps, working with platform APIs, and handling the full mobile development lifecycle.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Mobile App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine mobile applications across categories such as utilities, fitness/wellness, games, productivity, delivery, and content apps — for iOS, Android, or both, using native or cross-platform frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, Swift (iOS), or Kotlin (Android).
  • Implement responsive mobile UIs that follow platform conventions (iOS HIG, Material Design).
  • Integrate native device features (camera, push notifications, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Connect apps to backend APIs, handle offline state, caching, and synchronization.
  • Implement monetization features where required (in-app purchases, ads, subscriptions).
  • Evaluate AI-generated mobile code and refactor it for correctness, performance, battery use, and maintainability.
  • Debug platform-specific issues and prepare builds for distribution (TestFlight, Play Console).

Requirements and benefits

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in mobile app development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.
  • Candidates should have a strong foundation in mobile application development, platform-specific UI/UX patterns, and building stable, high-quality mobile experiences for iOS and Android. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work with native or cross-platform frameworks, integrate device APIs and backend services, and refine AI-assisted output into production-ready mobile applications. Strong attention to detail, performance awareness, and the ability to work independently are essential.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: React Native, Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI (iOS), or Kotlin/Jetpack Compose (Android).
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI patterns, navigation, state management, and platform guidelines.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, handling async data, and managing local storage.
  • Familiarity with native device APIs (notifications, camera, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Experience with mobile build tools, code signing, and submission to App Store / Google Play.
  • Experience implementing in-app purchases, ads, or subscriptions is a plus.
  • Familiarity with backend services such as Firebase, Supabase, or similar is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to performance, stability, and platform polish.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to ship complete mobile features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped mobile apps (required, with App Store / Google Play links preferred).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform is foundational to modern HPC and AI. At the center of this platform are CUDA Core Libraries that enable developers to build fast, reliable, and scalable GPU-accelerated software. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to develop the Rust experience for CUDA Core Libraries. You will design safe, idiomatic Rust APIs for GPU computing while integrating closely with native C/C++ components. You will join the team building the foundational libraries, algorithms, and language/runtime infrastructure that make CUDA a speed-of-light experience for developers and AI coding agents alike.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design and implement idiomatic Rust libraries and APIs for foundational CUDA functionality and GPU algorithms.

  • Build safe Rust abstractions over native CUDA and C/C++ interfaces.

  • Develop and maintain the C/C++ components required to support Rust-facing functionality.

  • Establish safe and efficient interoperability between Rust and C/C++, including interfaces that support downstream Python integration.

  • Optimize performance across Rust, native C/C++, and GPU execution boundaries.

  • Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, profiling, benchmarking, documentation, packaging, release, and maintenance.

  • Improve the Rust developer experience through examples, diagnostics, build integration, compatibility testing, CI, and collaboration with C/C++, Python, compiler, and runtime engineers.

  • Work with users to investigate and resolve issues related to safety, correctness, usability, compatibility, and performance.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of relevant software development experience.

  • Strong production programming skills in Rust and C/C++, with deep understanding of Rust ownership, lifetimes, traits, generics, concurrency, and unsafe code.

  • Experience developing systems libraries, runtime components, and developer-facing APIs.

  • Practical knowledge of foreign-function interfaces and integrating Rust with C/C++ software.

  • Solid understanding of systems software concepts, including performance, concurrency, and API design.

  • Experience with parallel, heterogeneous, or GPU programming.

  • Experience contributing to production or open-source software, including testing, profiling, benchmarking, packaging, and code review.

  • Ability to work independently, define scope, and drive complex projects to completion.

  • Strong written communication skills and ability to work effectively in large, multi-language codebases (Rust, C/C++, build systems, toolchains, CI).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Strong understanding of CPU/GPU architecture and performance optimization, with hands-on experience in GPU-accelerated stacks (CUDA C++/Python, PyTorch, JAX, Numba, CuPy, or similar).

  • Proficiency with modern C++ and GPU libraries such as Thrust, CUB, and libcudacxx.

  • Experience with compiler infrastructure and tooling, including LLVM, Clang, or MLIR.

  • Experience designing safe Rust abstractions over low-level or asynchronous systems, including exposure to Python interoperability.

  • Demonstrated interest in developer tools, library design, and improving developer productivity

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

raw.excerpt: About Positron AI Positron AI specializes in developing custom hardware systems to accelerate AI inference.
raw.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI specializes in developing custom hardware systems to accelerate AI inference. These inference systems offer significant performance and efficiency gains over traditional GPU-based systems, delivering advantages in both performance per dollar and performance per watt. Positron exists to create the world's best AI inference systems.

Role Overview

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Mid-End ASIC Engineer to own synthesis, timing convergence, implementation readiness, and logical design quality across our AI accelerator roadmap. This is a deeply technical, hands-on engineering role responsible for transforming high-quality RTL into implementation-ready netlists while driving timing closure strategy, constraint development, physical-aware optimization, and close collaboration between RTL designers and backend implementation partners. You will serve as the technical bridge between architecture, RTL, verification, and physical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Synthesis Methodology & Ownership

  • Define and own synthesis methodology across current and future ASIC generations, including scalable flows for RTL synthesis, constraint development, timing budgeting, QoR optimization, incremental synthesis, and hierarchical implementation.
  • Establish signoff criteria and methodology for synthesis deliverables.

Hands-On Synthesis & Constraint Development

  • Own hands-on synthesis using industry-leading EDA tools, including Cadence Genus and Synopsys Design Compiler (or equivalent).
  • Develop and maintain SDC constraints, clock definitions, false paths, multicycle paths, generated clocks, and MMMC environments.
  • Drive continuous improvement of synthesis QoR.

Timing Closure Leadership

  • Own logical timing closure and drive optimization across frequency, area, power, congestion, and wireability.
  • Perform root-cause analysis of timing bottlenecks and develop timing budgets across all chip partitions.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture and RTL teams to eliminate timing risks before physical implementation.

Physical-Aware Optimization

  • Partner closely with backend implementation engineers to drive physical-aware synthesis, retiming, register balancing, pipeline optimization, logic restructuring, and hierarchical timing budgeting.
  • Ensure RTL is implementation-friendly from the outset.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner closely with architecture, RTL, verification, physical design, DFT, IP providers, and backend design services to drive rapid issue resolution.

Vendor Technical Leadership

  • Serve as Positron's synthesis technical lead with external implementation partners, reviewing QoR, timing, area reports, and constraint methodology, and defining acceptance criteria.

AI-Enabled Engineering

  • Apply AI to improve timing analysis, QoR regression, constraint generation, timing debug, report analysis, documentation, and engineering automation.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of ASIC implementation experience, including multiple successful tapeouts.
  • Expert-level proficiency in synthesis methodology and flow development.
  • Deep expertise in timing closure across complex, multi-million-gate designs.
  • Expert-level command of Cadence Genus and/or Synopsys Design Compiler.
  • Strong SDC expertise, including constraint development and MMMC environments.
  • A solid grasp of RTL design principles and implementation-friendly coding practices.
  • Hands-on experience with advanced process nodes at 5nm and below.
  • Strong Tcl and Python scripting ability for automation and flow development.
  • Excellent debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI accelerators, CPUs, or GPUs.
  • Familiarity with LPDDR, PCIe, or SerDes interfaces.
  • Exposure to chiplet-based architectures and multi-clock SoC designs.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

What Success Looks Like

Within one year, this person will have established a production-grade synthesis methodology, delivered predictable timing closure, reduced implementation iterations, produced high-quality implementation-ready RTL, and built a scalable methodology to support future ASIC generations.

Why Join Us?

  • Play a foundational role in shaping the synthesis and timing closure methodology for next-generation AI inference accelerators.
  • Work at the cutting edge of AI hardware, directly influencing chips built to power frontier AI workloads.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $280,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.

Health and wellness

  • Fully company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
  • Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

Time off and flexibility

  • Unlimited paid time off — we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge
  • 13 paid company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with a company-provided computer and home office setup

Compensation and future

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

Visa Support

This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

About Fluent Software Group

Fluent Software Group acquires and grows vertical market software companies. Our portfolio businesses deliver mission-critical software to the industries they serve, and our Finance team provides the controllership, reporting, and M&A support that keeps the group scaling. As we continue to acquire, we are building a finance function that is technically excellent, systems-driven, and ahead of the curve on AI-enabled automation.

The Opportunity: Controller

The Portfolio Controller reports directly to the Portfolio Director of Finance and works as part of the broader Finance team. This is a technical role combining controllership, treasury, and compliance ownership. You will be the portfolio’s technical accounting specialist — owning the cash management process, ensuring robust internal controls and clean audit outcomes — while actively partnering with other department teams to raise reporting quality without becoming a bottleneck in day-to-day operations.

You will own the controllership and treasury function end-to-end: from intercompany reconciliation to IFRS 15 and 16, tax compliance, and cash management across your responsible businesses.

Location: Quebec, Ontario or Alberta (Remote)

International travel may be required for business process reviews and acquisition integration.

The salary range for this role is $100,000–$120,000 CAD per year. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the preparation and review of all assigned business month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close deliverables, including the statement of cash flows and dividend declarations.
  • Own the treasury function, including monthly cash requirements reporting, banking administration, debt management, working capital planning, coordinating dividend payment and maintaining accurate cash visibility at all times.
  • Coordinate tax compliance obligations where required, specifically transfer pricing arrangements, corporate tax support, and compliance deadlines, consulting with external advisors as needed.
  • Serve as the technical accounting lead for assigned businesses, providing guidance on IFRS 15, IFRS 16, IFRS 3, consolidations, and other complex accounting matters.
  • Lead the intercompany reconciliation and recharges process across assigned businesses, including resolving complex discrepancies and improving consistency between entities.
  • Own and strengthen the internal control environment across the portfolio, identifying financial risks, addressing control gaps, and supporting clean audit outcomes.
  • Support acquisition integration from a technical accounting perspective, including step plan adherence, revenue recognition checklists, and PPA model review, as well as aligning newly acquired businesses with Fluent’s accounting policies and controls.
  • Manage a team of 2–3, ensuring tasks are appropriately delegated and team members are coached and developed, while maintaining accountability for the accuracy and quality of their work.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders at the businesses and align priorities, financial risk, process improvements, and broader finance initiatives.

What We’re Looking For

  • A minimum of 7 years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including experience operating at a manager or controller level.
  • CPA, CA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
  • Previous experience operating at the manager level, with responsibility for overseeing key accounting processes and deliverables, including independently managing complex financial matters across multiple businesses or legal entities.
  • Proven people management or team leadership experience, including coaching, supporting, developing, and reviewing the work of team members.
  • Strong IFRS technical knowledge, specifically IFRS 15, IFRS 16, and IFRS 3, with essential consolidation accounting experience and exposure to complex intercompany transactions and internal controls.
  • Advanced Excel skills; demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to automate finance workflows; Python or Power Query experience is a strong advantage.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in both public practice accounting and a private industry accounting environment
  • Previous experience within the software industry, particularly in a recurring revenue or SaaS environment.
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite and Power BI

Why Fluent Software Group?

  • Entrepreneurial Energy: No two days look the same — you’ll work on meaningful problems with real business impact
  • High Autonomy, High Impact: Own your work from Day 1 in a team that trusts you to deliver
  • Serious Career Growth: Build your path within a growing global software portfolio
  • Learning-Driven Culture: Continuous improvement mindset across product, process, and people

Join Us

Help us scale incredible software companies — without losing their entrepreneurial edge. At Fluent, and Valsoft, you’ll make a real impact from Day 1.

Primary.Health is committed to protecting the health of every community through easy and affordable access to diagnostics. We provide program management software and program design services that let employers, schools and communities administer testing to prevent the spread of communicable diseases. Through our work with the largest, most complex organizations at the height of the pandemic, Primary has earned the experience and trust to provide superior diagnostic testing for COVID-19, flu and other conditions that threaten population health.

JOB TITLE: On-Demand Nurse Practitioner – Preventative Care

JOB TYPE: Contract (1099) |WEEKEND/HOLIDAY SHIFTS ONLY

LOCATION: Remote

REPORTING TO: Head of Strategic Initiatives

JOB SCOPE:

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Michigan-licensed Nurse Practitioner to join our team for an on-demand role. This position involves contacting patients with abnormal results from screening events and providing them with next steps and guidelines. The role is structured around scheduled events occurring on a weekend shift, with a minimum of two (2) Sundays per month. Routine shifts tend to be 6-8 hours.

MAJOR JOB DUTIES:

  • Contact patients with abnormal screening results to discuss findings and provide guidance on next steps.
  • Deliver clear and concise information about the nature of the abnormalities and potential health implications.
  • Develop and communicate personalized care plans, including necessary follow-up actions and preventive measures.
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to ensure comprehensive patient care.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of patient interactions and care plans.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Active Nurse Practitioner license in the state of Michigan.
  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience, preferably in a preventative care setting.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to deliver sensitive information with empathy and professionalism.
  • Proficient in electronic health records (EHR) systems.

The Account Manager is a pivotal role within JUICE, acting as the linchpin between our clients and our diverse team of marketing specialists. Your role is to ensure client satisfaction and campaign success, leveraging deep digital

marketing expertise to drive strategy and ROI.

About Us:

JUICE is a performance-driven, full-service digital marketing agency focused on helping brands scale through data-backed strategy, creative execution, and relentless optimization. Since its founding in 2017, JUICE has partnered with high-growth companies across e-commerce, lead generation, and user acquisition to build and manage scalable campaigns across paid social, search, SEO, email, and creative. With a strong emphasis on maximizing ROI and delivering measurable business outcomes, the team has generated over $1.3B in client revenue while continuously pushing the boundaries of performance marketing.

In September 2025, JUICE was acquired by ONAR, an AI-powered marketing platform and network of specialized agencies, further enhancing its capabilities through advanced technology, data integration, and a broader ecosystem of growth-focused solutions.

What you'll do:

  • Champion JUICE Values in Account Manager: Demonstrate JUICE's dedication to innovative, ROI-driven digital marketing solutions through every client interaction. Your role is pivotal in embodying the agency's ethos of relentless optimization and strategic growth, ensuring our clients' campaigns thrive.
  • Strategic Client Leadership: Act as the primary liaison between JUICE's clients and our team of marketing specialists. While not directly managing specialists, you'll take ownership of campaign strategies, coordinating efforts across channels to achieve client objectives. You'll ensure campaigns are cohesive, strategic, and tailored to meet specific client KPIs and goals.
  • Collaborative Campaign Ownership: Work alongside paid social and search specialists as colleagues, guiding the strategic direction and integration of client campaigns. Your deep understanding of digital marketing channels will enable you to influence strategies effectively, ensuring client success.
  • Client Communication Mastery: Serve as the primary point of communication for clients, translating their goals into actionable plans for the team. You'll build and maintain strong relationships, ensuring clients are continuously informed, engaged, and satisfied with their campaign progress and outcomes.
  • Continuous Strategy and Optimization: Utilize your expertise in digital marketing to monitor campaign performance closely, leveraging analytics to make data-driven decisions. You'll lead the charge in optimizing strategies to exceed client expectations and achieve outstanding results.

Aim to enhance team productivity and accountability through meticulous project tracking and reporting.
  • Leadership Through Influence: Your role demands strong leadership qualities. You'll need to inspire and influence colleagues to drive client success, fostering a collaborative environment that leverages each team member's expertise.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 4+ years of digital marketing experience (paid social/search)
  • Deep foundational knowledge of marketing and digital marketing including funnels, conversion rate optimization, etc.
  • An understanding of how paid social works together with paid search in a marketing mix
  • Strong team player who works well with others and prioritizes the development of his or her people

● Proven success leading teams

  • Ability to quickly identify and implement key changes that benefit the overall business

● Data-driven decision maker

  • Ability to coach teams of varying skill sets & levels of seniority

  • A fast-moving, collaborative environment focused on growth and impact
